purpose: Measure whether one /search-v2 call with num_pages=3 returns up to 30 slots and how many quota units it consumes. The collector compares provider-reported remaining quota before and after the run. If consumption is 1 unit, deep pagination can be bundled; if 2-3, bundling saves nothing and later batches keep num_pages=1. The query is new (foreign comparison stratum), so returned jobs are also usable corpus data.
